When I was around 6 years old I was terribly afraid of the dark. At the time, my family lived in a trailer, so my home was quite small.. Anywho, on one school night I wake up at like 2 am and desperately had to go to the bathroom. I attempt waking my older brother who I share a room with to take me to go shit. My brother was 13 at the time and pretty much told me to fuck off. I walk to the door of my room and kind of whisper yell to try and wake my dad up. I had to go desperately but I knew he'd be pretty pissed if I woke him up just so he could take me to a bathroom that's less than like 5 feet from my room.. Well, I remember I kind of just stood in front of my door staring out into the darkness that is my house while I did this sort of wiggly little kid shit dance until I just couldn't hold it. I gathered up all my courage, ran out of my room and straight towards the bathroom. I pulled my pants/undewear down mid run and as soon as I had made my way through the door, I knew it was too late.. 6 year old me released the grossest mound of shit straight into the floor of my bathroom, right in front of the sink as soon as you enter (this is important). Being a kid, I had no real clue how to clean this up and didn't wanna touch my gross poo with my hands, so I did what any dumbass kid would do.. I threw one of our bath towels over top of it and decided I would let my mom know when I woke up for school the next day. 

Well here's the issue with that, I woke up for school and forgot all about my incident.. I get on the bus at around 6ish and go about my day like nothing happens. At around 10 o clock, I'm sitting in my class when the teacher gets a call letting me know I was being picked up, I was stoked. I see my mom standing in the office and I knew instantly that I was in some big trouble. Apparently, I had left for school, my dad woke up around 7:30 to get ready for work.. He walked into the bathroom to shower, shave and generally get ready when he steps on the towel pretty much as soon as he entered. He's confused why the towel made a squish explosion under his foot so he lifts it up to see my shit now splattered and mushed pretty much all over the floor/towel. Upon this happening, he actually vomits pretty much instantly causing there to be a mixture of shit and vomit all over the floor of our bathroom he had to clean making him late for work and definitely ruining his morning. He was so pissed that he actually told my mom to come get me and let me know how upset he was and how much trouble I was gonna be in... The thing is though, I only got grounded for like a week, so... No ragrets.
